北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京霾天，出门记得戴口罩，气温 7℃ 稍凉，注意防护哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is hazy. Wear a mask, it's a bit cool at 7℃. Stay safe!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好，体感 5℃ 左右，早晚温差大，别忘添衣哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and feels like 5℃. Big temp difference, remember to add clothes!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴天，体感 6℃，风力轻柔，出门愉快，注意保暖。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny, feels like 6℃ with light wind. Enjoy your day, stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，气温 16℃，湿度大，记得带伞，小心着凉。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy, 16℃ with high humidity. Remember an umbrella and stay warm.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，气温 16℃，体感舒适。湿度高，出门记得带伞。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, 16℃ and feels pleasant. High humidity, remember your umbrella.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 6℃ 稍凉，记得添衣，小心感冒哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but feels cool at 6℃. Remember to add clothes to avoid colds.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴好，体感 4℃，风力不小，多穿一点，注意防风。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny, feels like 4℃ with notable wind. Dress warmly and guard against wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 17℃，体感适中。记得带伞，享受美食！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 17℃, feels moderate. Remember an umbrella and enjoy good food!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，气温 14℃，体感舒适。出门散步，心情好哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny, 14℃ and feels comfortable. Go for a walk, enjoy your day!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，气温 14℃，微风舒适。注意补水，保持好心情。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, 14℃ with a gentle breeze. Remember to hydrate and stay cheerful.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗，气温 20℃，体感温暖。是出游的好天气！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is sunny, 20℃ and feels warm. It's great weather for an outing!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，气温 -1℃，体感 -4℃，很冷！务必多穿防寒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy, -1℃ and feels like -4℃. Very cold! Be sure to dress warmly.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 1℃ 左右，风力稍大，出门记得多穿点。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy, feels like 1℃ with some wind. Remember to dress warmly when out.
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，气温 14℃，体感舒适。紫外线强，注意防晒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny, 14℃ and feels comfortable. UV is strong, remember sun protection.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，体感 6℃，风力不小，多穿点，感受海风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 6℃ with strong wind. Dress warmly and enjoy the sea breeze.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 3℃ 左右，湿度大，注意保暖防潮。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like 3℃ with high humidity. Stay warm and guard against dampness.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 -2℃，海边风大，务必多穿，小心着凉。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -2℃ with strong sea wind. Dress very warmly to avoid colds.
